description.value: Zorba's Bakery & Foods is a family-operated Greek and Mediterranean food manufacturer that has been producing pita bread, phyllo pies, dips, and falafel for the North American market since 1985, with roots tracing back to a village bakery on the Greek island of Evia. Products use locally sourced BC ingredients including Okanagan yogurt and Fraser Valley vegetables, and include vegan, gluten-free, and lactose-free options. OSM tags the location as a takeaway-only bakery shop, though the business also distributes wholesale to grocery retailers across the region.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms Zorba's is a family-owned Greek/Mediterranean food manufacturer (pita bread, dips, phyllo, falafel) operating since 1985, and the BC phone number 604-439-7731 appears in the website header matching OSM. However, the website's /contact-us/ subpage contains clear template artifacts: a California area code (209-337-5705), a placeholder email (beyond@info.com), a mismatched address (137 Carriage Court vs. OSM's 7173 Buller Avenue), and Lorem ipsum copy throughout — suggesting the site template was never fully customized. The 'Find a retailer' language and wholesale product focus raise doubt about whether this is a walk-in retail stop accessible to passing cyclists.
concerns: Address mismatch: OSM shows '7173 Buller Avenue, Burnaby' but website /contact-us/ page shows '137 Carriage Court' — likely a website template placeholder that was never replaced.

Website contact page displays a California area code (209-337-5705) as the primary call-us number, alongside the correct BC number 604-439-7731 in the site header — the 209 number appears to be a template artifact.
Website contact page shows placeholder email 'beyond@info.com' instead of the real address info@zorbasfoods.ca listed in OSM.
Multiple pages contain Lorem ipsum placeholder text, indicating the website template was never fully customized — reduces reliability of all website content.

Business appears to operate primarily as a wholesale food manufacturer/distributor ('Find a retailer for Zorba's products near you'); unclear whether walk-in retail purchase is available to passing cyclists despite OSM's takeaway=only tag.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: It is unclear whether this is an accessible walk-in retail stop for cyclists or primarily a wholesale food manufacturer; the website's 'Find a retailer' language and the heavily template-artifact-laden contact page (wrong address, California phone number, placeholder email) make it impossible to confirm key details without direct verification.
enrichment_extras.notes: The BC phone number 604-439-7731 is confirmed by its appearance in the website header across all pages. The OSM record itself (shop=bakery, takeaway=only, wheelchair=yes) is plausible, but the website discrepancies warrant a site visit or phone confirmation before including in the directory.

wow_evidence: family-operated Greek and Mediterranean food manufacturer...since 1985, with roots tracing back to a village bakery on the Greek island of Evia
